_about: Where data that came from an online source goes (docs/44 'Data: nothing duplicated, lost or looped', the table's
Nightscout row): per origin, per target, 'yes' (sent as from any first-hand source), 'no' (never) or 'off' (off unless
the person turns it on, a switch that says why). Rows: 'nightscout' = glucose read from the source site;
'nightscout-treatments' = treatments pulled from it (read-only here). Targets: libreView (the LibreView upload: it
sends the sensor Sukrara reads, one uploader per account), tidepool (the Tidepool upload: the site's own uploader
may send there already, twice would count double), nightscoutSame (Nightscout upload to the source's own site:
nothing goes back to where it came from, the upload pauses while that site is the source and treatments go both ways
through the source), nightscoutOther (upload to another site), healthConnect, followers (Sukrara's own sharing, your
glucose only), garmin (Sukrara Aura shows the card's glucose, whatever the source), broadcasts (apps on the phone:
they carry a Libre 3's live reading, its serial and life count; rule 7 adds that no loop should take internet
readings for a sensor's, and apps that want a site's glucose read the site themselves). Someone else's glucose is
never shared or uploaded whatever its source (sources.json keying 'owner'); a Mac on its own uploads nothing. The
treatments Sukrara logs itself keep today's rules, plus both ways with the source site.
LibreLinkUp (docs/44 step 2, rules 2, 3 and 6): 'librelinkup' = glucose read from LibreLinkUp (the official app
uploads it to LibreView). LibreView takes one uploading device per account, so while LibreLinkUp is the source the
LibreView upload sends nothing at all, treatments neither ('libreView' 'no'; it resumes when Sukrara reads the sensor,
with Take over). 'on' = on unless the person turns it off, a switch that says why: Tidepool can link LibreView itself
(US only), so the switch says it would count twice there. LibreLinkUp brings no treatments: the ones logged in Sukrara
keep today's rules (Tidepool, Nightscout, followers). 'nightscoutSame' doesn't apply (no site is the source): 'yes'.
